info.title: browser-mcp REST API
info.description: Stateless REST/JSON surface over the same live browser as the MCP server. Each call is an independent POST; `?profile=` selects the shared browser to drive (the same profile an MCP agent uses). Pass an explicit `tab_id` to target a specific tab.

post.summary: Open a URL in a new tab, or navigate an existing tab if tab_id is given
post.description: Open a URL in a new tab, or navigate an existing tab if tab_id is given. Waits for DOMContentLoaded plus a short request-idle settle. Does NOT return page content — call browser_read afterwards. Returns HTTP status, final URL, title, and tab_id.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

url.description: Absolute URL to navigate to. http(s) only by default — file://, data:, javascript:, and private/loopback IPs are blocked; set BROWSER_MCP_ALLOW_FILE_URLS=1 or BROWSER_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS=1 to opt in.

tab_id.description: If set, navigate this existing tab instead of opening a new one

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.summary: Read the current (or specified) tab
post.description: Read the current (or specified) tab. mode=markdown (default) extracts the main article via Readability and returns Markdown; mode=text returns body innerText; mode=html returns raw HTML. Use selector to narrow to an element. Output is capped at max_chars (default 50000, overridable globally via BROWSER_MCP_MAX_CHARS).

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

mode.description: markdown: main article via Readability, converted to Markdown (best default). text: body innerText. html: raw HTML of the page or selected element.

selector.description: CSS selector to narrow extraction to a specific element (outerHTML/innerText of that node)

compact.description: Strip nav / header / footer / aside / script / style / svg / iframe and aria landmark chrome (banner, navigation, complementary, contentinfo, search) before rendering. Also drops [aria-hidden=true] and [hidden]. Works for all modes — useful for dashboards / SPAs where Readability bails out and the raw body is drowned in nav boilerplate. Defaults to false for markdown (Readability already handles chrome) and true for text/html.

tab_id.description: Tab to read from; defaults to the active tab

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.description: List all open tabs with their tab_id, title, and URL. The active tab is marked with →.

post.summary: Click an element
post.description: Click an element. target_type picks the locator strategy (most reliable first): `role` (e.g. target="Sign in" + role="button"), `label` (form fields by <label>), `text` (visible text, default), `placeholder`, `testid`, `selector` (CSS escape hatch). Playwright auto-waits for the element to be visible/enabled/stable; we also wait for network idle after the click.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

target.description:
What to click. Meaning depends on target_type:
- text: visible text, e.g. "Sign in"
- role: accessible name when combined with `role` param, e.g. "Sign in" + role="button"
- label: <label> text, e.g. "Email" (for inputs)
- placeholder: input placeholder text
- testid: data-testid value
- selector: CSS selector

target_type.description: How to interpret target. Prefer `role` for buttons/links (most reliable), `label` for form fields, `text` for generic visible text. `selector` is the escape hatch.

role.description: ARIA role when target_type='role'. Common: button, link, textbox, checkbox.

tab_id.description: Tab to act on; defaults to the active tab

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.summary: Fill an input/textarea/contenteditable with text
post.description: Fill an input/textarea/contenteditable with text. target_type picks the locator strategy (default `text`); `label` is usually most robust for forms (e.g. target="Email"), `selector` is the CSS escape hatch. If submit=true, presses Enter after typing. Auto-waits for the field to be actionable before filling.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

target.description: Target to fill. See target_type for semantics.

target_type.description: Locator strategy (default 'text'). Prefer 'label' for form fields (e.g. target="Email") — most robust against markup changes; 'selector' is the CSS escape hatch.

text.description: Text to type. Existing value is replaced (fill semantics).

submit.description: Press Enter after typing (e.g. to submit a search or login form)

tab_id.description: Tab to act on; defaults to the active tab

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

target.description: Optional element to focus first. If omitted, the key is sent to the page (active element).

post.description: Fill a whole form in one call. `fields` is applied in order; each field sets exactly one of `value` (text), `checked` (checkbox/radio), or `options` (native <select> by value). Aborts on the first failing field (reports which). `submit: true` presses Enter on the last field; `submit: { target }` clicks a submit button afterwards.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

target_type.description: Locator strategy. `label` is usually cleanest for forms.

options.description: Select option value(s) in a native <select>.

fields.description: Fields to fill, applied in order. Each sets exactly one of value/checked/options.

submit.description: After filling: true presses Enter on the last field; an object clicks that submit element.

tab_id.description: Tab to act on; defaults to the active tab

Returns up to `limit` snippets (default 10), each with surrounding context and a best-effort CSS selector for browser_click/browser_type — the selector is depth-capped and may not be unique on complex DOM, so prefer role/label/text locators when possible.

parameters.name: profile

query.description: Substring to search for in the page's visible text (case-insensitive)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return

tab_id.description: Tab to search in; defaults to the active tab

parameters.name: profile

selector.description: CSS selector to wait for. Provide this OR `condition` (not both).

condition.description: JS expression polled until truthy (page.waitForFunction), e.g. "window.__ready === true". Provide this OR `selector`.

state.description: Element state to wait for (only with `selector`)

post.summary: Take a PNG screenshot of the current tab
post.description: Take a PNG screenshot of the current tab. Default: viewport. full_page=true captures the entire scrollable page.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

full_page.description: false: viewport only (1280x900). true: the entire scrollable page. Ignored if `selector` is set.

selector.description: If set, capture only this element (CSS selector). Takes precedence over full_page. Element is scrolled into view automatically. Returns an error if not found.

tab_id.description: Tab to capture; defaults to the active tab

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

post.summary: Return an accessibility snapshot of the page — a compact tree of semantic elements (role, name, value, state) based on the platform a11y API
post.description: Return an accessibility snapshot of the page — a compact tree of semantic elements (role, name, value, state) based on the platform a11y API. More reliable than Markdown for interacting with SPAs, form-heavy pages, or custom components without stable selectors. Pair with browser_click using target_type="role" or target_type="label" for robust interaction. Supports `selector` to scope to a subtree, `max_depth` to cut tokens, and `format` ('yaml' compact by default, 'json' raw).

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

tab_id.description: Tab to snapshot; defaults to the active tab

selector.description: If set, snapshot only the subtree rooted at this CSS selector. Useful for focusing on a form or panel without dragging in the whole page.

max_depth.description: Limit tree depth. Deeper children are replaced with a 'N hidden children' summary. Unset = no limit (default). Use to cut tokens on huge pages.

interesting_only.description: Playwright filter: when true (default), prune decorative/hidden nodes. Set false to get the full raw a11y tree (much more verbose).

compact.description: Strip to interactive elements only (buttons, links, textboxes, checkboxes, menu items) plus structural landmarks (headings, nav, main, dialogs, forms). Much more token-efficient when you just need 'what can I click/type'. Defaults to false — but when `diff_against` is set, defaults to true, because generic-container noise produces useless diffs otherwise.

store_as.description: If set, save this snapshot under this name for later diffing. E.g. 'before-login'. Overwrites any previous snapshot with the same name.

diff_against.description: If set, compute a diff vs a previously-stored snapshot with this name. Returns lists of added / removed / changed elements instead of the full tree. Combine with `store_as` to roll forward (diff vs 'before-login' + store as 'after-login').

format.description: Output format. 'yaml' (default) is a compact indented tree, human-readable and token-cheap. 'json' is the raw Playwright AXNode for programmatic use.

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.summary: Assert a condition on the current page
post.description: Assert a condition on the current page. Retries up to `timeout_ms` before failing, so you don't need a separate browser_wait for flaky conditions. Supports element state (visible/hidden/enabled/disabled), text (text_equals / text_contains / text_matches), form input (value_equals), element count, page URL / title. Returns PASS or FAIL with both expected and actual values in the error body.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

assertion.description: What to assert. Element state: visible|hidden|enabled|disabled. Text: text_equals|text_contains|text_matches (regex). Form: value_equals. Count: number of matching elements. Page: url_*, title_*.

target.description: Element target. Required for all element/text/count assertions; ignored for url_* and title_*.

expected.description: Expected value. Required for text_*/value_*/count/url_*/title_* assertions. For count it must be a number; for *_matches it's a regex string (compiled and run on the server — keep it simple, avoid catastrophic-backtracking patterns).

timeout_ms.description: How long to retry the assertion before failing.

tab_id.description: Tab to act on; defaults to the active tab.

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.summary: Grant (or clear) browser permissions like camera, microphone, geolocation, notifications, clipboard read/write
post.description: Grant (or clear) browser permissions like camera, microphone, geolocation, notifications, clipboard read/write. Use before navigating to a site that will prompt the user. `grant: "all"` grants every supported permission; `"none"` clears all grants; an array picks specific ones. Applies to the current tab's origin by default.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

grant.description: Which permissions to grant to the origin. 'all' grants every supported permission (camera, mic, geolocation, notifications, clipboard R/W, etc). 'none' clears all grants. An array lets you pick specific ones.

origin.description: Origin to grant the permissions for. Defaults to the current tab's origin. Use a specific origin like 'https://example.com' to pre-grant before navigation.

tab_id.description: Tab whose origin to use when `origin` is omitted. Defaults to active tab.

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.summary: Save the current page to disk
post.description: Save the current page to disk. Formats: 'pdf' (Chromium's print-to-PDF, headless only), 'mhtml' (single-file archive with all resources inlined — excellent for offline analysis), or 'html' (raw page HTML). Parent directories are created automatically.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

format.description: Output format. 'pdf' — Chromium's native print-to-PDF (headless-only). 'mhtml' — single-file archive with resources inlined, great for offline review. 'html' — raw page HTML as-is.

path.description: Where to write the file. By default it must stay inside this profile's download sandbox (~/.browser-mcp/downloads/<profile>/): relative paths resolve against the sandbox and absolute paths that escape it are rejected. Parent directories are created automatically. Set BROWSER_MCP_ALLOW_ANY_WRITE_PATH=1 to write to any path (relative paths then resolve against the supervisor's cwd).

full_page.description: PDF only: include full scrollable page (true) vs just viewport (default).

tab_id.description: Tab to save; defaults to the active tab.

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.summary: Upload one or more files to an <input type="file"> element
post.description: Upload one or more files to an <input type="file"> element. Paths are validated to exist before the call is made. For <input multiple>, pass several files; otherwise one. Locator strategies: selector (CSS), label (<label>-associated), testid (data-testid).

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

target.description: The <input type=file>. See target_type for semantics. `label` is usually cleanest for forms.

target_type.description: Locator strategy. selector / label / testid. (role/text rarely apply to file inputs.)

files.description: Paths to files to upload. By default each must live inside this profile's upload sandbox (~/.browser-mcp/uploads/<profile>/): relative paths resolve against the sandbox and absolute paths that escape it are rejected (set BROWSER_MCP_ALLOW_ANY_UPLOAD_PATH=1 to upload from anywhere). For <input multiple>, pass several; for single-file inputs, pass one. Each file is validated to exist.

tab_id.description: Tab to act on; defaults to the active tab

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.summary: Trigger a download and capture the resulting file
post.description: Trigger a download and capture the resulting file. action='click' clicks a button/link; action='navigate' sends the tab to a direct download URL. The file is saved to `save_to`; if that ends with '/' or is an existing directory, the server-suggested filename is used.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

action.description: What to do to trigger the download. 'click' clicks a target element. 'navigate' points the tab at `url` (e.g. a direct download URL).

target.description: For action='click': the button/link that triggers the download.

url.description: For action='navigate': URL that triggers the download.

save_to.description: Where to save the downloaded file. By default it must stay inside this profile's download sandbox (~/.browser-mcp/downloads/<profile>/): relative paths resolve against the sandbox and absolute paths that escape it are rejected (set BROWSER_MCP_ALLOW_ANY_WRITE_PATH=1 to disable). If it ends with '/' or points to an existing directory, the server's suggested filename is appended.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the download to start AND complete.

tab_id.description: Tab to act on; defaults to the active tab

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

400.description: Invalid arguments (zod validation) or invalid profile name.

post.summary: Read, write, or clear cookies in the current browser profile
post.description: Read, write, or clear cookies in the current browser profile. action='get' returns a list (optionally scoped to URLs). action='set' adds/updates cookies from the `cookies` array — each entry needs either (domain+path) or a single url. action='clear' wipes all cookies.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

action.description: What to do. 'get' returns cookies for given URLs (or all). 'set' adds or updates cookies from `cookies` array. 'clear' removes all cookies (or a filtered subset).

urls.description: For 'get': list of URLs to scope to. If omitted, all cookies in the profile are returned.

cookies.description: For 'set': cookies to add/update. Each needs either a single `url`, or both `domain` and `path`.

expires.description: Unix seconds. -1 or absent = session cookie.

200.description: The tool ran. `ok:true` with `data`/`content`, or `ok:false` for a tool-level failure (e.g. a failed assertion or element not found) — both are HTTP 200.

post.summary: Inspect recent network requests (ring buffer of last 500 across all tabs in the profile)
post.description: Inspect recent network requests (ring buffer of last 500 across all tabs in the profile). Filter by tab_id, URL regex, HTTP method, min_status (e.g. 400 for errors only), or failed_only. Each entry shows time, status, method, URL, resource type, and duration. Useful to debug SPA behaviour: what API calls fired, what failed, what returned 4xx/5xx.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

tab_id.description: Only entries from this tab. Omit to see all tabs in the profile.

limit.description: Keep at most this many of the most recent matching entries (printed oldest-first).

url_regex.description: JS regex; only URLs matching are returned. Compiled and run on the server against recent URLs — keep the pattern simple (no need for catastrophic-backtracking constructs).

failed_only.description: Only return requests that failed (net::ERR_*, blocked, aborted).

min_status.description: Only return responses with status >= this. Use 400 to see errors only.

post.description: Inspect recent browser console output (ring buffer of last 500 across all tabs in the profile): console.log/info/warn/error/debug plus uncaught page errors (level 'pageerror'). Filter by tab_id, level, or text_regex. Great for debugging SPA errors the UI swallowed.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

tab_id.description: Only entries from this tab. Omit to see all tabs in the profile.

level.description: Filter by level. 'pageerror' = uncaught exceptions on the page.

limit.description: Keep at most this many of the most recent matching entries (printed oldest-first).

text_regex.description: JS regex; only messages whose text matches are returned. Compiled and run on the server — keep it simple.

post.description: Return a captured HTTP response body (what an XHR/fetch returned). Only small texty/JSON responses are captured (last 50, size-capped). Filter by url_regex and method; index counts back from the most recent match (0 = latest).

parameters.name: profile

url_regex.description: JS regex; only responses whose URL matches are considered. Compiled and run on the server.

index.description: Which match to return, counting back from the most recent (0 = latest, 1 = previous, …).

post.summary: Read/write the active tab's localStorage or sessionStorage (per-origin)
post.description: Read/write the active tab's localStorage or sessionStorage (per-origin). action=get returns a key (or all keys), set writes key+value, remove deletes a key, clear wipes the store. localStorage persists in the named profile.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

action.description: get (a key, or all if `key` omitted), set (`key`+`value`), remove (`key`), or clear all.

area.description: Which store: localStorage (default, persists in the profile) or sessionStorage.

key.description: Storage key. Required for set/remove; optional for get.

value.description: Value to store. Required for set.

tab_id.description: Tab whose origin to use; defaults to the active tab. Storage is per-origin.

post.summary: Set how the next native dialog (alert/confirm/prompt) is handled — call this BEFORE the action that triggers it
post.description: Set how the next native dialog (alert/confirm/prompt) is handled — call this BEFORE the action that triggers it. action=accept (OK) or dismiss (Cancel); prompt_text fills a prompt; persist=true applies to all dialogs. Without this, dialogs are auto-dismissed.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

action.description: How to respond to the next native dialog: accept (OK) or dismiss (Cancel).

prompt_text.description: Text to enter into a window.prompt() before accepting. Ignored for alert/confirm.

persist.description: false (default) = apply to the next dialog only, then revert to auto-dismiss; true = apply to all dialogs until changed.

post.summary: Change browser settings at runtime
post.description: Change browser settings at runtime. All parameters are optional — pass only what you want to change. Viewport and color_scheme apply to the current (or specified) tab. User-agent and locale apply to the whole browser context (all tabs).

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Which profile (shared live browser) to target. Defaults to 'default'.

device_preset.description: Full device emulation preset. Restarts the browser context (all tabs are closed). Sets viewport, deviceScaleFactor, isMobile, hasTouch, and userAgent. Available: iphone-15, iphone-se, ipad, ipad-pro, pixel-8, galaxy-s24, desktop-retina. Overrides viewport_preset, ua_preset, and device_scale_factor if set.

viewport_preset.description: Viewport preset (no context restart). mobile=375x812, tablet=768x1024, desktop=1280x900, desktop-hd=1920x1080, desktop-2k=2560x1440. Ignored if device_preset or viewport_width/viewport_height are set.

viewport_width.description: Custom viewport width in pixels (no context restart). Must be set together with viewport_height.

viewport_height.description: Custom viewport height in pixels (no context restart). Must be set together with viewport_width.

device_scale_factor.description: Device pixel ratio, e.g. 2 for retina. Restarts the browser context (all tabs are closed).

is_mobile.description: Enable mobile mode (mobile viewport behavior + touch). Restarts the browser context.

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent string. Overrides ua_preset if both are set.

ua_preset.description: User-Agent preset. Ignored if user_agent or device_preset is set.

extra_headers.description: Custom HTTP headers merged into all future requests (e.g. an auth token). Context-wide, no restart.

tab_id.description: Tab to apply viewport/color_scheme to; defaults to the active tab. Ignored when context restarts.

200.description: Released ({ ok:true, released:boolean }).

bearerAuth.description: Required only when the server is started with an API key (BROWSER_MCP_API_KEY).

ok.description: false for a tool-level failure (still HTTP 200).

data.description: Structured result (shape depends on the tool); absent for some action-only tools.

content.description: Human/LLM-formatted blocks (text, or base64 image for screenshots), kept for parity with MCP.
